title: FairDiverse: A Comprehensive Toolkit for Fair and Diverse Information Retrieval Algorithms

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated in search ranking pre-processing by measuring group fairness, individual fairness (yNN), and demographic parity on the COMPAS dataset, specifically analyzing the impact on groups like females.

Evaluated using the COMPAS dataset in search ranking tasks by calculating group fairness and individual fairness metrics, with a focus on mitigating bias against disadvantaged groups like Black individuals.
Measured by assessing ranking diversity, group fairness, and utility loss on intersectional demographic groups (e.g., the 'Female-Black' group) using the COMPAS dataset.

Evaluated in recommendation tasks by computing utility distribution metrics such as Max-Min Fairness (MMF), GINI index, Entropy, and MinMaxRatio across different item categories (e.g., Steam game categories) to ensure fair exposure for long-tail or minority items.

Measured in search result diversification tasks using the ClueWeb09 dataset by evaluating how well search rankings represent diverse subtopics and user intents using metrics like ERR-IA, α-nDCG, and Subtopic Recall (S-rec).
